_instructions.how_to_use: Copy this file to resume_data.json and replace every [PLACEHOLDER]. Nothing else needs to change. Your copy is gitignored.
_instructions.bullets: Write each bullet as: accomplished X, as measured by Y, by doing Z. Lead with the outcome, name the number, then the method. A bullet with no number describes a job description rather than your work.
_instructions.length: One page for under ten years of experience. Cut the oldest role before you cut a number.
_instructions.sections: section_order decides which sections appear and in what order. Remove a name from it and that section does not exist in the PDF. Delete any section you cannot fill honestly.
_instructions.ordering: Experience first once you have industry experience. Projects or education first before that.
_instructions.separators: Write a plain | between items. The pre-processor typesets it. Never write LaTeX in this file.
_instructions.cover_letter_date: Leave cover_letter.date empty and the letter carries the date it was compiled. Rebuild before you send it. Set a value only if you need to pin a specific date.
_instructions.summary: Optional. Strong experience speaks for itself, so summary is left out of section_order by default. Add it back if you are changing field and need to explain the move.

cover_letter.subject: Application for [ROLE_TITLE], [REQ_ID]
paragraphs: I am applying for the [ROLE_TITLE] role. I work on [SPECIALISM], most recently [WHAT_YOU_SHIPPED] which [WHAT_IT_DID], and I would like to do that on [THEIR_TEAM_OR_PROBLEM].
The work closest to yours is [PROJECT]. [THE_HARD_PART_IN_ONE_SENTENCE]. [WHAT_YOU_DID] and [THE_MEASURED_RESULT]. [WHY_IT_RESEMBLES_THEIRS].
I would welcome the chance to talk about [SPECIFIC_PROBLEM_THEY_HAVE]. Thank you for your time.
